original_validation_gates.requirement: Every manifest asset resolves to exactly one contract and exported descriptor; all child media files exist, hashes match, names are stable, provenance is complete and expected variants are declared. Refuse placeholder/unproduced states in release mode.

Import actual native builds with zero missing references; verify color space, alpha premultiplication, crop, pivots and sorting; atlas gutters remain clean under scaled/filtered previews; fonts contain required glyphs. Compare uncompressed reference to compressed output on both native targets.

Exercise every harbor/stage/cosmetic in a deterministic capture harness at reference viewports and text scales, default/reduced motion and UI states. No clipped controls, illegible contrast, visual reward mismatch or state-dependent missing sprite.

Capture worst-case active scene and transition peak texture memory including atlas padding/mips; verify package size and frame time against qualified device targets. Long background/resume and repeated scene changes show no retained asset growth.

Verify all package members decode on both targets, loops are seamless, no clipping/clicks, volume buses and mute persist, concurrent cues respect voice limits, background interruption/headphone change/resume is correct and paused earnings generate no delayed audio burst. Readable visual equivalents remain.

Every equipped/preview/pass/shop cosmetic points to the same registered appearance. Supporter grants only cosmetic.shop.01 through .04 and audio.soundtrack; soundtrack download/restoration works with documented redistribution rights. All exports remain cosmetic-only.

Every narrative text states true objectives and rewards; ending needs no paid pass/all Note sinks; season archival copy does not invent expiration. Accessible calibration copy gives the same reward and cost. Credits, help, recovery and privacy descriptions match real behavior.

original_variant_contract.producer_stages: Five presentations per family correspond exactly to 0/25/50/75/100; gift/unlock state does not create a sixth cosmetic or milestone presentation.
original_variant_contract.motion: Every animated harbor/producer/cosmetic/season presentation has a static reduced-motion state showing the same unlock and reward information. No flashing or camera shake carries unique information; particles, bounce and parallax can be disabled independently of progression.
original_variant_contract.text: All player-facing copy uses externalized IDs and the qualified font. Test 100%, 150% and 200% text scale with reflow/scrolling on minimum phone and tablet; pseudolocalized strings must not overlap costs, cover confirm buttons or truncate retained-progress details.
original_variant_contract.color: Unavailable/selected/complete/error states have shape/text/icon differences rather than relying only on color. Theme and cosmetic colors cannot hide economic state.
original_variant_contract.cosmetics: Each item has an equipped view, owned/locked preview and thumbnail; previews use the same visual asset and cosmetics do not change hitboxes or core logic.
original_variant_contract.audio: All information in milestone/Rechart/interaction cues has a visual/text equivalent. Music and SFX have independent persistent volume controls plus mute. Mute/background/resume must not replay stale reward queues.

original_audio_delivery.source_master_format: PCM WAV, proposed 48 kHz / 24-bit; final source/import formats confirmed in B02/ART-G03.
original_audio_delivery.runtime_format: Engine-supported compressed streamed music and suitably imported short cues, qualified on iOS/Android; do not assume a codec solely from its extension.
original_audio_delivery.mix_target: Document music/SFX loudness and peak measurements; proposed true-peak ceiling -1 dBTP and no audible clipping. Exact loudness balanced in-client; headphones and device speakers both reviewed.
original_audio_delivery.package_members: Each package descriptor contains member IDs, source WAV/license paths, runtime exports, loop points, gain/bus, duration, hashes and credits. Soundtrack descriptor lists reused ambient masters, metadata and download artifact hash.

original_provenance_rules: Keep generation prompt, tool/model metadata when returned, references and original output for AI bitmap sources; record unavailable metadata explicitly instead of inventing a seed/model.
For original authored SVG, source text, procedural assets and audio, record authorship and source revision. Do not assume tool availability implies permission to use a reference.

For external media/fonts/music, retain the actual license and attribution requirements and verify modification, in-game redistribution, commercial use and platform export permissions. Soundtrack must separately permit standalone download redistribution.
Credits are compiled from provenance, including font/audio obligations. Unknown, missing or contradictory rights evidence fails the asset release gate.
Never embed private source paths, prompts, reference photos or licensed masters into public build metadata unless intended and authorized.
